english.title: Importer of birds fail to comply with the requirements for their transport

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related product regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an importer of birds, failed to comply with Article 7 Commission Regulation (EC) No 318/2007, in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 9(2) of Schedule 2 to and regulations 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.

english.notes: For an offence committed on or after 14/12/19 see offence wording document H20666

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
